caracteristicas.titulo: From Cayambe's soil to markets around the world
caracteristicas.subtitulo: We take advantage of the equatorial line's most demanding geographic conditions to grow superior-quality roses. Our process combines traditional agricultural knowledge with precise logistics to anticipate your needs, ensuring absolute freshness and flowers that stand out against any competition. We are direct growers with daily availability, secure packaging, and personalized service.

carta1.descripcion: High-altitude cultivation: Strong stems and large buds under the equatorial sun.

carta2.descripcion: Hand harvesting: Rigorous selection at the exact opening stage.

carta3.descripcion: Global distribution: High-protection packaging for international freshness.

Caracteristicas_red.subtitulo: Experience the perfect balance between the majesty of nature and export precision. From local florists to large global distributors, Lladeal supplies your business with superior-quality roses that exceed every standard. Transform your catalog with longer-lasting flowers, vibrant colors, and a reliable supply in every season.

lista.descripcion: Whether you are a boutique florist or a global wholesale distributor, Finca Lladeal adapts to your scale. We supply everything from exclusive varieties to large export volumes, always with personalized attention that matches your business pace.
We take the potential of floriculture to the highest level. Through rigorous quality control, large buds, and superior vase life, our roses compete successfully in the world's most demanding markets.

Keep your supply chain efficient without complications. We integrate seamlessly with your traditional import channels, managing the process from Cayambe so your orders arrive with freshness and hydration fully preserved.
